relations.text: ADIは外部のウェハー・ファウンドリ購入の過半を、TSMCなど限られた供給元から調達する
relations.text_en: ADI buys more than half of its external wafer and foundry services from a limited number of suppliers, such as TSMC

source.label: Analog Devices 10-K
source.quote: Additionally, more than half of the Company’s purchases of external wafer and foundry services are from a limited number of suppliers, such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) and others.
source.note: 供給元の一例としての記載です。
source.note_en: TSMC is cited as an example supplier.

relations.text: ASEのマレーシア子会社の取締役会が、2026年3月にADIのマレーシアの製造子会社の買収を決議した
relations.text_en: In March 2026, the board of directors of ASE Malaysia resolved to acquire Analog Devices's manufacturing subsidiaries in Malaysia

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: and South Korea to expand power chip module packaging and testing and lead frame packaging, and in March 2026, the board of directors of ASE Malaysia resolved to acquire Analog Devices’s manufacturing subsidiaries in Malaysia to enhance supply chain resilience and manufacturing diversity.
source.note_en: Describes a resolution by ASE Malaysia's board.

relations.text: ADIはBank of America, N.A.が管理代理人を務める第4次改訂版リボルビング・クレジット契約(2025年4月11日付)を結んでいる
relations.text_en: ADI has a Fourth Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement dated April 11, 2025, with Bank of America N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: Analog Devices 10-K
source.quote: Our Fourth Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement, dated as of April 11, 2025, with Bank of America N.A. as administrative agent and the other banks identified therein as lenders (the Revolving Credit Agreement) provides for a five year unsecured revolving credit
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。
